For 0<b<b* solving b+2b³=1, explicit five-word difference tuple and Q,Z bounds yield nonempty r interval Q/(1-b³)<r<min(1,Q/Z); odd symmetry gives distinct second orbit. Jacobian J²=-b I, so both strict-itinerary cycles locally attracting (five-step multipliers magnitude b^(5/2)); origin stable.
